meta.name: agent-team
meta.description: 产品经理与项目管理专家在应对复杂项目时，使用此技能可动态组建包含“执行、指挥、评审”的专属AI团队。实时查看多智能体辩论与决策全过程，共享统一上下文记忆，一键完成从会议决策到系统构建的全流程高效协同！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 组建AI团队协同处理复杂项目，实时查看多智能体决策过程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要多智能体协助管理复杂项目、决策与执行。
copy.tagline_en: Build an AI team to handle complex projects, watch multi-agent decisions live
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need multi-agent assistance in managing complex, decision-heavy projects.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会按任务动态组建 AI 团队,成员分指挥、执行、评审三类角色,共享同一份上下文记忆,并把智能体之间的发言、辩论和决策过程实时展示出来。产出会议记录、方案或可运行代码。
howto.when: 当需要多个智能体协同完成任务时,或需要管理特定场景的智能体组合时触发。也可以直接点名要某种预设团队,如技术决策团队、OPC 团队等。

say.text: 请用技术决策团队评估微服务架构的可行性
say.note: 多位智能体从各自角度发言、辩论后给出结论

say.text: 请用 OPC 团队构建 AI 短视频领域的系统
say.note: 按战略分析、产品架构、自动化工程三步走

say.text: 请用产品团队制定这款产品的定价策略
say.note: 市场、财务、评审角色参与讨论

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude dynamically assembles an AI team split into command, execution and review roles, all sharing one context memory, and shows their remarks, debates and decisions in real time. Outputs meeting notes, plans or runnable code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a task needs multiple agents working together, or when you need to manage an agent combination for a specific scenario. You can also name a preset team, such as the technical decision team or the OPC team.

say_en.text: Use the technical decision team to assess the microservices architecture
say_en.note: Several agents speak and debate before a conclusion

say_en.text: Use the OPC team to build a system for short-video AI
say_en.note: Runs strategy, product architecture, automation steps

say_en.text: Use the product team to set pricing for this product
say_en.note: Market, finance and review roles join the discussion
